rng: NumPy PCG64, seed + fixed case ordinal
bootstrap: Paired percentile resampling, stratified by which method ran first. Preserve 9 ruled-first and 8 triangle-first pairs in each replicate. Statistic is median(triangle ns)/median(ruled ns), not median of paired speed ratios. Linear 2.5/97.5 quantiles. Exploratory 95% resampling interval.
sign_test: Two-sided exact paired sign test under null equal win probability. Exclude exact latency ties. Holm familywise adjustment across all five fixed cases at alpha 0.05. Independently report ruled-first/triangle-first median ratios and wins/losses.
scope: Secondary statistical analysis of the already published 17-pair CPU measurements, not preregistration before those timings and not a new timed run. Conditional on sufficiently independent/representative paired timing trials; serial dependence or runtime drift can affect inference. No cross-device, GPU, ArcGIS software or real-DTM performance claim. Keep all five cases and every nonsignificant outcome; do not change the source timings or raw records.
